name: slide-deck-auditor
description: Strict automated acceptance rules and thresholds for slide deck engineering standards

bottom_deadspace_void.description: Flags hardcoded short container heights (< 620px) or short card grids that leave a massive (>200px) dead space void at the bottom of the 1080p canvas.

typography_floor.description: Enforces 1080p projection typography floor with three tiers: (1) eyebrow/footer metadata tags: 18~24px; (2) slide body text: >= 30px; (3) card titles: >= 36px. Different tiers apply to different UI zones.

elevator_shaft.description: Flags column flex containers combining space-between with low content density causing dead space voids. Also flags marginTop: 'auto' that pushes content to the bottom, creating mid-card voids when content is sparse.

letterboxing_void.description: Flags image containers with black backgrounds and objectFit contain causing severe letterboxing borders.

semantic_color_inversion.description: Flags defense or mitigation sections using attack/danger red accent colors.

ai_fluff.description: Flags empty AI marketing buzzwords, theatrical slogans, preachy metaphors, and non-technical filler phrases.

deck_integrity.description: Ensures slide deck exports default array of pages and provides matching speaker notes for every page.

information_density.description: Enforces 1080p slide deck information density ceiling to prevent content bloat (Rule 6). Limits nested micro-boxes per card (max 3), multi-column card micro-boxes (max 1), total boxes per slide (max 6), per-slide character count (max 500 chars), and multi-column card text count (max 160 chars).

vertical_overflow.description: Flags stacked containers (e.g. top banner card stacked with multi-column card grids) that exceed the 1080p canvas available viewport (>680px), colliding with the running footer.

code_wrapping_defect.description: Flags wordBreak: 'break-all' applied to code blocks in multi-column cards that tears code keywords across lines.

eyebrow_character_ceiling.description: Enforces header eyebrow badge quality rules: (1) must not contain phaseTag; (2) must not contain time ranges (e.g. 00:00 - 03:00); (3) must not contain colloquial slang (e.g. 幹嘛); (4) must not use sentence-ending punctuation; (5) character count <= 16; (6) font size must be within 18~24px range. Eyebrows are wayfinding metadata, not slide titles.
